fields.description: The listing's SKU, item_code::serial. GunBroker keeps it unchanged across relists, which makes it the stable key for matching a sold listing back to a gun — the item number does not survive a relist.
fields.label: SKU

fields.description: The GunBroker item number this line sold under. A cache, not a key: GunBroker issues a new one every time it relists.
fields.label: GunBroker Item ID

fields.description: The marketplace-facilitator tax GunBroker allocated to this line. Reported per line, booked per order.
fields.label: Line Sales Tax

fields.description: OrderItem.isFFLRequired. Decides both whether the FFL-received gate applies to this order and whether the per-item licence document fee accrues.
fields.label: FFL Required

fields.description: This line's own final value fee, tiered on its own price and rounded on its own. Summing per-line fees is what GunBroker bills; running one order total through the tiers under-charges every multi-gun order.
fields.label: Final Value Fee

fields.description: Why this line could not be matched to, or could not reserve, a gun in stock.
fields.label: Reservation Error
